description: This file provides diagnostic and utility functions for the backend of a task management platform, including environment parsing, status payload creation, error responses, logging utilities, and middleware for request logging.

methods.name: List[str] _parse_csv_env(name: str, default: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated environment variable into a list of trimmed strings, returning default if not set or empty.

methods.name: bool _bool_env(name: str, default: bool = False)
methods.description: Parses environment variables into boolean values based on common truthy strings.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] build_status_payload( *, app_version: str, db_configured: bool, secret_key_configured: bool, cors_origins: List[str], websocket_origins: List[str], warnings: Optional[List[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Generates a JSON-compatible dictionary representing the application's runtime status, including version, configuration flags, origins, uptime, and warnings.

methods.name: JSONResponse db_unavailable_response(details: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a standardized JSON response indicating database unavailability with hints for resolution.

methods.name: logging.Logger make_logger(name: str, level: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates and configures a structured logger with JSON-like formatting, with adjustable log level.

methods.name: None log_event(logger: logging.Logger, event: str, **fields: Any)
methods.description: Logs a structured event as a JSON string, with fallback to plain text on serialization failure.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[str]] parse_cors_and_ws_from_env()
methods.description: Parses CORS and WebSocket allowed origins from environment variables, with sensible fallbacks.

methods.name: attach_request_logging_middleware(app_logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Returns a coroutine middleware function for logging basic request details asynchronously.

ctags.name: build_status_payload
ctags.signature: ( *, app_version: str, db_configured: bool, secret_key_configured: bool, cors_origins: List[str], websocket_origins: List[str], warnings: Optional[List[str]] = None, )

ctags.name: log_event
ctags.pattern: /^def log_event(logger: logging.Logger, event: str, **fields: Any) -> None:$/

ctags.name: make_logger
ctags.pattern: /^def make_logger(name: str, level: Optional[str] = None) -> logging.Logger:$/
